summary: Partisans destroyed a critical railway bridge in Russia's Arkhangelsk region, severing the sole northern rail line supporting military logistics and strategic resource transport. Russia launched massive combined drone and missile strikes across Ukraine, targeting energy infrastructure including the Trypillia TPP and Kyiv substations, while guided aerial bombs hit multiple frontline regions. Trilateral talks resumed in Abu Dhabi with Ukraine, Russia, and the US, though Kyiv expects minimal immediate results.
key_points: Partisans blew up the Viled River railway bridge in Arkhangelsk region, collapsing it under a train and halting traffic on the Kotlas-Vorkuta line, the only rail link to Komi Republic and northern Russia. (Source: @eRadarrua/129814)
Drones struck the 123rd Aviation Repair Plant in Staraya Russa, Novgorod region, a key facility repairing Il-76, Il-78, and L-410 transport aircraft and aviation engines. (Source: @eRadarrua/129812)
Russia attacked the Trypillia TPP in Kyiv region with combined ballistic missiles and reactive drones, causing "extremely serious" damage and complicating air defense. (Source: @UkraineNow/85208)

Russian tactical aviation launched guided aerial bombs on Zaporizhzhia city, Donetsk, Kharkiv, Sumy, and Zaporizhzhia regions; high Iskander-M ballistic missile threat reported from Bryansk region. (Source: @kpszsu/94818, @kpszsu/94816, @kpszsu/94846, @mon1tor_ua/78088)

Massive reactive Shahed drone waves targeted Kyiv, Chernihiv, Sumy, Dnipropetrovsk, Poltava, Zhytomyr, Vinnytsia, Rivne, Volyn, Odesa, and Mykolaiv regions, including a Geran-5 rocket toward Vyshhorod. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78092, @eRadarrua/129823, @kpszsu/94843)

Ukraine and Norway agreed on MANPADS procurement, accelerated air defense missile supplies, 20mm ammunition for F-16s, NASAMS integration, and Norwegian drone purchases from Ukrainian manufacturers ahead of the November 17 Ramstein meeting. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23988)

Trilateral talks resumed in Abu Dhabi; Ukraine expects minimal results from first round but progress on prisoner exchanges; US proposed administrative boundary changes in Donbas to let Russia claim full control. (Source: @UkraineNow/85216, @UkraineNow/85218, @UkraineNow/85212)

Russian strike on Epicentr mall in Kropyvnytskyi, Kirovohrad region, caused large fire and two severe burn injuries; woman killed and two injured in Vyshhorod district, Kyiv region, from Russian attack. (Source: @eRadarrua/129829, @UkraineNow/85206)

sections.executive_summary: Partisans destroyed a critical railway bridge in Russia's Arkhangelsk region, severing the sole northern rail line supporting military logistics and strategic resource transport. Russia launched massive combined drone and missile strikes across Ukraine, targeting energy infrastructure including the Trypillia TPP and Kyiv substations, while guided aerial bombs hit multiple frontline regions. Trilateral talks resumed in Abu Dhabi with Ukraine, Russia, and the US, though Kyiv expects minimal immediate results.

points: Ukraine and Norway discussed military aid priorities including MANPADS procurement, accelerated air defense missile supplies, 20mm ammunition for F-16s, NASAMS integration, and Norwegian purchases of drones from Ukrainian manufacturers ahead of the November 17 Ramstein meeting in Brussels. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23988)

Ukrainian officials expect minimal results from the first round of trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi but anticipate progress in the second round; the US is described as acting "symmetrically" without taking sides, while Ukraine prioritizes humanitarian track and prisoner exchanges. (Source: @UkraineNow/85216, @UkraineNow/85212)

Ukrainian air defense engaged reactive Shahed drones over Kyiv region, including a strike on a substation in Vyshhorod, a regular Shahed in Desnyansky district, and multiple drones over Vyshneve and Irpin; air raid alerts sounded in Kyiv at 09:40 and 11:52. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78091, @mon1tor_ua/78094, @mon1tor_ua/78093, @eRadarrua/129807, @eRadarrua/129827)

A Russian strike in Vyshhorod district, Kyiv region, killed one woman and injured two others, destroying a two-story private house and garage; explosions were also reported in Kyiv, Zhytomyr, and Kyiv region with no enemy targets identified. (Source: @UkraineNow/85206, @mon1tor_ua/78090)

GUR head Kyrylo Budanov awarded State Emergency Service divers Artem Orlov, Denys Frolov, and Mykhailo Khyzhnyak for restoring critical equipment at a Kyiv TEC during six days in icy water after a Russian strike; Budanov emphasized veteran support codex as priority. (Source: @UkraineNow/85204, @UkraineNow/85223)
Patriot missile deficit will persist approximately one year; Ukraine expects 600 PAC-2 missiles produced in Germany in 2027-2028 to alleviate shortages. (Source: @UkraineNow/85205)

Partisans blew up the Viled River railway bridge on the Kotlas-Vorkuta line in Arkhangelsk region, collapsing it under a freight train; the bridge is the sole rail link connecting central Russia with Komi Republic and northern regions, used for military logistics, coal, oil products, and strategic raw materials. (Source: @eRadarrua/129814)

Drones struck the 123rd Aviation Repair Plant (JSC "123 ARZ") in Staraya Russa, Novgorod region, causing explosions, fire, power and internet outages; the facility repairs Il-76, Il-78, L-410 transport aircraft and aviation engines; governor reported damage to industrial facility and two summer houses, no casualties. (Source: @eRadarrua/129812)

Russian forces struck the Epicentr mall in Kropyvnytskyi, Kirovohrad region, with a double tap: first hitting cars in parking lot, then the building, causing a large-scale fire and two severe burn injuries hospitalized. (Source: @eRadarrua/129829)

Russian tactical aviation launched guided aerial bombs on Zaporizhzhia city, Donetsk region, Kharkiv region, Sumy region, and Zaporizhzhia region; high threat of Iskander-M ballistic missile launches reported from Bryansk region. (Source: @kpszsu/94818, @kpszsu/94816, @kpszsu/94846, @mon1tor_ua/78088)

Russia intensified attacks on Trypillia TPP in Kyiv region since late September, changing tactics to use combined ballistic missiles and reactive drones within short timeframes, complicating energy infrastructure defense; consequences described as "extremely serious" by Centrenergo. (Source: @UkraineNow/85208)

Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov stated Russia has a position document on new Eurasian security architecture; US proposed changing administrative boundaries of Ukrainian regions to allow Russia to declare capture of all Donbas without transferring Ukrainian-held cities. (Source: @UkraineNow/85218, @eRadarrua/129837)
Enemy forces advanced in Rai-Oleksandrivka according to updated frontline mapping. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23987)
Russian guided aerial bombs struck Donetsk region as part of broader tactical aviation strikes across multiple frontline regions. (Source: @kpszsu/94816)

A reactive Shahed drone launched from Donetsk region targeted Dnipropetrovsk region, Pavlohrad district, indicating continued use of drones from occupied eastern territories. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78092)
GUR identified individuals responsible for bombing a school in Komyshuvakha, naming perpetrators from Moscow. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23986)

Multiple reactive and strike UAV groups operated in Chernihiv region: 2 reactive past Berezna, 1 strike at Kuchynivka; 2 reactive past Kulikivka, 3 strike at Tupychiv, 1 at Makiivka; UAVs on Borzna; 1 reactive at Mena, 1 at Kholmy; 1 past Kipty to Otrokhy at low altitude; reactive UAVs in Olshivka area toward Kyiv region. (Source: @eRadarrua/129804, @eRadarrua/129822, @eRadarrua/129838, @eRadarrua/129816, @eRadarrua/129810, @kpszsu/94815)

Reactive UAVs launched from Sumy region toward Chernihiv region (Dmytrivka district) on southwest course; high threat of Iskander-M ballistic missiles from Bryansk region; guided aerial bombs struck Sumy region. (Source: @kpszsu/94852, @mon1tor_ua/78088, @kpszsu/94846)

Reactive UAVs detected in north of Dnipropetrovsk region heading toward Poltava region (Kobelyaky) and Kremenchuk on western courses; multiple groups from Kharkiv region through north Dnipropetrovsk toward Kremenchuk. (Source: @kpszsu/94839, @kpszsu/94848, @kpszsu/94842, @kpszsu/94849)

Reactive UAV on border of Chernihiv and Kyiv regions with constantly changing course; reactive UAV from Chernihiv to north Kyiv region on western course; reactive UAVs on border of Kyiv and Chernihiv regions in Savyn area. (Source: @kpszsu/94847, @kpszsu/94824, @eRadarrua/129853)
Russian tactical aviation launched guided aerial bombs on Zaporizhzhia city and Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @kpszsu/94818, @kpszsu/94816)

Reactive UAVs launched from Black Sea toward Ochakiv; reactive UAV past Zatoka on westward course; threat of strike UAVs in northeast Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @kpszsu/94825, @kpszsu/94853, @kpszsu/94817)
Reactive Shahed drone from Black Sea aquatoria targeted border of Mykolaiv and Odesa regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78092)
Reactive UAV toward Kamianske from east in Dnipropetrovsk region. (Source: @kpszsu/94821)
